gemma4-12b-qat.label: Gemma 4 12B (QAT)
gemma4-12b-qat.note: Default. Quantization-aware trained, so tool-call formatting survives 4-bit. 256K native context, trimmed to 32K here for memory.

gemma4-12b-mlx.label: Gemma 4 12B (MLX)
gemma4-12b-mlx.note: Same model on Apple's MLX backend. Usually faster on Apple silicon. Try it once the QAT tag works.

glm47-flash-q2.label: GLM-4.7-Flash (dynamic 2-bit)
glm47-flash-q2.note: Higher ceiling, 2-bit damage. 30B-A3B MoE squeezed to 10.5GB by Unsloth dynamic quant. RUN toolcall-check BEFORE TRUSTING: low-bit quantization degrades structured output before it degrades prose.

gemma4-e4b.label: Gemma 4 E4B
gemma4-e4b.note: Middle option if 12B feels thin and you have headroom to spare.
